objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the command injection weakness of a WordPress 6.5.4 site with plugins and a MySQL 8.0 database and read the flag in /opt/flag.txt.
hints: Find the input the server hands to a system command, and how shell metacharacters are treated.
Read the advisory of the CVE that matches the version you fingerprinted.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class lets your input reach a system shell?

steps.title: Find the plugin
steps.prompt: Which WordPress plugin, besides the defaults, is installed? (name or slug)

steps.title: Name the CVE
steps.prompt: Which CVE id covers that plugin version (1.3.5)?
